name: flame.knowledgebase/accept-claim.v1
description: Accept an exact research statement and reason with validated citations in one Project.

name: flame.knowledgebase/accept-work.v1
description: Accept a reusable method version, current claim revisions, and exact native Project deliverable bytes.

name: flame.knowledgebase/delete.v1
description: Delete a document and its index at the inspected revision.

name: flame.knowledgebase/import.v1
description: Import or replace a user document and its embedding index at the inspected revision; use zero for a new document. A document with a project is visible only within that Project.

name: flame.knowledgebase/list-claims.v1
description: List a Project's latest research decisions and current evidence status.

name: flame.knowledgebase/list-work.v1
description: List saved Work identities and immutable method versions in one Project.

name: flame.knowledgebase/list.v1
description: List the indexed user documents visible to the caller, shared documents and its Project's own, with their revisions.

name: flame.knowledgebase/move.v1
description: Move an inspected material to another Project without re-embedding its content. This withdraws access from the original Project.

name: flame.knowledgebase/read-claim.v1
description: Read a retained research decision with exact page and line citations, checking current Project access and changes to each cited passage.

name: flame.knowledgebase/read-work.v1
description: Revalidate the Work's original claim revisions and native bytes against current Project access and the latest chart revision.

name: flame.knowledgebase/read.v1
description: Read a stored document or one numbered page at the current or retained revision. Current Project access is checked before returning source metadata or text.

name: flame.knowledgebase/reindex.v1
description: Rebuild an existing document's embedding index from its stored original text at the inspected revision through the configured embedding role.

name: flame.knowledgebase/search.v1
description: Retrieve cited chunks from the indexed user documents visible to the caller, shared documents and its Project's own, through the configured embedding role.
